commands.formal: PYTHONPATH=src python demo.py --finite-packet-transport --bunny-mesh data/stanford_bunny/cache/bun_zipper.ply --bunny-artifacts artifacts --bunny-figures figures --render-output render_res

direct_photon_evaluation_transfer.reason: only allowed after a validated small optimization

energy_linearity.claim_scope: linear in transported packet energy for fixed geometry; nonlinear in geometry

decomposition.continuous_source_motion_component: C-B; normal-line source positions move with fixed identities
decomposition.detector_component: included continuously in A/C/D via cubic detector integral
decomposition.mode_A: autodiff/JVP with moving sources and frozen packet-owner IDs
decomposition.mode_B: central FD, field/path attenuation only, frozen source points and normals
decomposition.mode_C: central FD, recomputed source positions/normals, frozen owner IDs
decomposition.mode_D: central FD with rerasterized field, recomputed sign-changing cells, source roots, and outward packet owners
decomposition.source_sample_root_component: D minus owner-recomputed intermediate; sign-changing-cell selection and source roots are rebuilt
decomposition.visibility_owner_component: owner-recomputed intermediate minus C; no first path root is ever selected

real_scene.eta_rule: eta=1e-6 median(||grad F||) for each positively scaled representation

limitations: finite packet attenuation is an algorithmic surface-barrier model, not a claim of exact radiometry
source sign-changing-cell selection and source root identities remain discrete
fixed finite packet quadrature can retain integration variance
soft-vs-hard image differences are measurement-model bias, not geometry error

required_variants.A: hard visibility plus continuous cubic detector

scope: continuous zero-set-native forward energy transport operator; no novelty or physical-exactness claim

sphere_cap.formula: phi(s)=0 for s>=1; 1 for s<=-1; ((1-s)^2(2+s))/4 otherwise

surface_opacity.reason: the zero set represents a surface; one complete crossing is intended to have angle-independent opacity

transport_definition.optical_depth: tau=kappa integral mean_u psi_epsilon(d_F(x(t)+r u))*|n_F dot omega| dt
transport_definition.packet_support: fixed Sobol quadrature in a uniform 3D ball
transport_definition.source_topology_frozen_or_remaining: sign-changing-cell selection and normal-line root identity remain discrete

transport_derivative.image: continuous cubic detector projection and kernel derivatives are differentiated through autodiff
transport_derivative.not_differentiated: discrete sign-changing-cell count/order and source root identity
